QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_24

question.text: Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations and the 2021 amendment, which body's members 'shall be responsible for the decisions taken' in an AIF fund management organisation (unless the Large-Value-Fund / INR 70 cr waiver applies)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2021, members of the Investment Committee are responsible for decisions taken and must ensure compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations. Exemption is available only where the LVF / INR 70 crore per-investor waiver carve-out applies. The Trap: The Advisory Committee, distributors and auditors are not decision-accountability bodies under the 2021 amendment. The IC (decision body) is distinct from the Advisory Committee (non-binding recommendations). Note: Page 277 of the workbook places decision-accountability on IC members, subject to the LVF / INR 70 crore waiver.
